# APS — Process and Automation Systems

> APS (apsinox.com) provides turnkey industrial process automation, OEM food & beverage processing machinery, and authentic industrial spare parts with 48-hour RFQ response target for verified enterprise enquiries worldwide.

## Core Offerings

- [OEM Direct Sourcing](https://apsinox.com/#oem-direct): 100% genuine provenance through manufacturer-authorised channels, specification compliance cross-referenced to original engineering datasheets, zero tolerance deviation, and full traceability.
- [Process and Automation Systems](https://apsinox.com/#automation-systems): Turnkey mechanical & electrical installation, automated control architectures, PLC programming, DCS integration, SCADA engineering, and commissioning handover.
- [Process Machinery & Line Solutions](https://apsinox.com/#process-machines): Complete modular processing lines for CSD (Carbonated Soft Drinks), Dairy, Juice & Liquid Food, Industrial Water Treatment (RO, UV, Media Filtration), Clean-in-Place (CIP skids), and Product Recovery (pigging systems).
- [Critical Process Spares & Components](https://apsinox.com/#spares-components): Direct OEM replacement spares for sanitary pumps (centrifugal, lobe, progressive cavity), process valves (mix-proof, butterfly, aseptic diaphragm), plate and tubular heat exchangers, field instrumentation (pressure, flow, level, temperature), and IP66 stainless electrical cabinets.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://apsinox.com/#faq): Procurement details, genuine OEM verification, supported brands, and delivery horizons.

## Dedicated Hubs & Technical Catalogs

- [Sanitary Pump Spares](https://apsinox.com/spares/pumps/): Mechanical seals, impellers, shafts, and casing O-rings for sanitary centrifugal, rotary lobe, and progressive cavity pumps.
- [Hygienic Process Valves](https://apsinox.com/spares/valves/): Replacement seal kits, plug assemblies, actuators, and digital control tops for mix-proof, single-seat, and butterfly valves.
- [Plate & Tubular Heat Exchangers](https://apsinox.com/spares/heat-exchangers/): OEM-grade clip-on and glued elastomer gaskets (NBR, EPDM, FKM) and replacement plates (AISI 316L, Titanium Gr. 1).
- [Process Instrumentation & Sensors](https://apsinox.com/spares/instrumentation/): Electromagnetic & Coriolis flowmeters, flush pressure transmitters, Pt100 RTDs, and radar level sensors.
- [CSD Syrup Room Equipment](https://apsinox.com/systems/csd-syrup-rooms/): Modular packages for carbonated soft drinks, continuous sugar dissolving, in-line ratio blending, deaeration, and carbonation skids.
- [Automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) Skids](https://apsinox.com/systems/cip-skids/): 2-tank to 5-tank automated sanitization stations, chemical recovery loops, inline conductivity dosing, and mix-proof manifolds.
- [Industrial Water Treatment & RO Skids](https://apsinox.com/systems/water-treatment/): Reverse osmosis (RO) plants, multi-stage multimedia filtration, and sanitary UV disinfection reactors.
